title: 第118章 你不配成为我的对手！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 原本众人对唐逸的话，还存有怀疑的。唐画可是三元及第的状元，你说他抄袭他就抄袭了？但现在看到老福王急匆匆进来，手中还提着剑一副要砍人的样子，现场很多人都愣住了。“福王，真是福王爷！”“我去，难道是真的，唐画的三元及第真有问题？”“不会吧，要真是这样，那就是妥妥的欺君之罪，唐家是活腻歪了……”“……”盯着拎着剑快步走上台的福王，现场瞬间喧嚣起来。有人震惊，有人错愕，有人幸灾乐祸……好家伙，整个沈园诗会，都成为唐家的家族秀了，简直就是秀天秀地秀九族啊！这时的议论声铺天盖地，然而，此时唐画看着快步走往台上走来的福王，只觉得周围的声音渐渐飘远。仿佛周围所有的一切，都化为了一个巨大的漩涡，将他给彻底吞噬了。诗是唐逸写给福王的？他窃取的是福王的诗词？唐逸害我！“唐逸，你是故意的？”唐画怒目瞪着唐逸，眼睛喷火。“早就提醒过你的，是你不信。”唐逸双手枕着头靠在椅子上，声音平静。“你敢肆无忌惮地抄袭，无非就是觉得你是陛下钦点的三元及第的状元，有恃无恐。”“毕竟陛下，是不能有错的。”唐逸微微侧眸，睨着唐画：“可是你忘记了一个前提，那就是错的不是陛下，错的是你。”“你觉得陛下堂堂九五之尊，会为你的错误买单？”“你，也太看得起你自己了。”何况，从现在这种情况看，皇帝明显很想借势收拾刘温和唐敬等人。你抄袭，陛下不仅不会帮你打掩护，他会高兴得会须一饮三百杯呢，毕竟你给他提供了一个收拾你爹的好借口。当然，唐逸只能在心里暗暗吐槽，这种话是不能众目睽睽之下说出来的。而听到唐逸的话，唐画脸色瞬间失去了血色，哪里还有之前的半点狂妄和嘚瑟。唐逸的确是提醒过他，可那时的唐逸在他眼中，不过是蝼蚁一般的废物罢了。他需要在意一个废物的话吗？但现在，他整个人被恐惧吞噬，终于知道怕了。唐逸说得没错，他还没有重要到让堂堂一国皇帝，为他背弃原则的地步。“小逸，我错了，帮帮我，帮帮我……”唐画看着福王手中铮亮的长剑，双腿都在发软，差点一头跪在地上：“小逸，我们是兄弟啊！我们是血浓于水的兄弟，求你帮帮我。”“我不想死，我不能死啊！”唐画站在唐逸身侧，低着头攥着拳，用只能两人听到的声音说道。声音急促而颤抖，几乎都快哭出来了。如果对手是唐逸，他颠倒黑白，随意都能编造出一套说辞，让自己立于不败之地。毕竟唐逸很难自证清白，可面对福王，他连颠倒黑白的勇气都没有。那可是当年靖康耻，敢单枪匹马和北狄大军拼命的人！更重要的是，对方是皇亲！手上握有实权的皇亲！唐逸听着唐画的求救，看向他的目光变得更加的不屑起来。但凡唐画敢将错就错，敢众目睽睽之下和福王辩一场，就算败了，他唐逸也会高看他一眼。结果，这家伙不过是个虚伪的利己主义者罢了！事情对自己有利，便将事情无数倍放大，恨不得让天下人都知道。可一旦局面对自己不利，便会想方设法先将自己摘出去。可耻！“求我？”唐逸嗤笑。“唐画，你今日这架势，恨不得将我千刀万剐挫骨扬灰吧？”“一上来，就拾掇姜云娜那女人找我麻烦，贬低践踏我，不就是为给你出手创造更多名正言顺的机会吗？”“她们铺垫得很不错，你该大发神威将我踩在脚下，这才是你该做的事。”“但你现在却求我……放过你？！”说到后面，唐逸的声音已经冰冷下来。放过唐画？开什么玩笑！今日为了杀他，这家伙可谓是做足了准备，哪一项不是奔着让他身败名裂去的？他，早该死了！“唐逸，你别太过分了。”“我们都是唐家子弟，真闹到生死的地步，丢的是唐家的脸。”“父亲……父亲不会放过你的。”见到老福王已经上台，唐画眼睛都红了。他直接搬出了唐敬，用唐敬威胁唐逸。该死的，我求你是你的荣幸，你还敢嘲讽我？然而。唐逸闻言睨了他一眼，目光就像是在看个白痴。“唐家？和我有关系吗？”“你不是喜欢颠倒黑白能言善辩吗？那就和福王好好辩辩吧！”话落，唐逸站了起来冲着怒气冲冲的福王拱手一礼：“见过王爷，抱歉，原本只是遵从王爷的意思，将词写下来……没想到，被人冒用了。”“小子，这和你没关系。”老福王冲着唐逸随意挥挥手，冷眸便盯着唐画。当初，他让唐逸誊抄《春望》，是想和老将军狄苍一样，要他小诗仙的真迹。却没想到阴差阳错，被唐画拿到殿试上装逼去了。那是属于他的诗词，竟然有人敢盗用！“你，就是三元及第的状元，唐画是吧？”福王提起剑，指着唐画：“谁给你的胆子，敢偷唐逸小子写给本王的诗，用到殿试上嘲讽和羞辱陛下，以夺状元的？！”听到这话，全场几乎瞬间安静了下来。所有人的目光，齐齐落在了唐画的身上。连同炎文帝，刘温，唐敬等人也都齐齐看了过去。此时，他们脸色都出奇一致，全都阴沉至极，也都在等唐画的答案。当日殿试，唐画一首《劝谏诗》惊艳全场，要是这首诗真是抄袭唐逸的，那将会是整个大炎科举史上最大的黑幕！打的，是整个大炎朝廷，大炎文坛的脸。顷刻间，整个鹿鸣湖的气氛都压抑起来，宛若暴风雨前的宁静。而唐画本来就是个又菜又爱玩的废物，只会暗戳戳阴飕飕地搞事情，根本就没有那么强大的心态去支撑他的野心。他早就吓得半死，此时见到福王抵在喉咙前的剑尖，吓得差点没当场跪在地上。“王爷，这……这是个误会。”“我没有抄袭，我……我只是借用……”唐画声音颤抖。读书人借用，怎么能是抄袭呢？
content_en: Originally, everyone still had doubts about Tang Yi's words.Tang Dynasty Painting is the number one scholar in Sanyuan. If you say he plagiarized, then he plagiarized?But now that they saw Old King Fu hurried in, holding a sword in his hand as if he was going to kill someone, many people at the scene were stunned."Prince Fu, it's really Prince Fu!" "Let's go, is it true that there is really something wrong with the Three-Yuan Ranking in Tang paintings?" "No, if that's true, it would be a crime of bullying the emperor. The Tang family is really tired of living..." "..." Staring at Prince Fu who walked quickly onto the stage with a sword, the scene instantly became noisy.Some people were shocked, some were astonished, some were gloating... My goodness, the entire Shen Yuan Poetry Club has become a family show of the Tang family. It is simply a show of the nine clans!The discussion at this time was overwhelming. However, at this time, Tang Hua looked at King Fu walking quickly towards the stage, and felt that the surrounding voices gradually faded away.It was as if everything around him turned into a huge whirlpool, swallowing him completely.The poem was written by Tang Yi to King Fu?Did he steal King Fu's poems?Tang Yi harmed me!"Tang Yi, did you do this on purpose?" Tang Hua glared at Tang Yi angrily, eyes spitting fire."I warned you a long time ago, but you don't believe it." Tang Yi leaned on the chair with his head in his hands and his voice was calm."You dare to plagiarize unscrupulously, just because you think that you are the number one scholar who has been selected by His Majesty for three yuan and have nothing to fear." "After all, Your Majesty cannot make mistakes." Tang Yi glanced sideways slightly, looking at Tang Hua: "But you forgot one premise, that isIt's not your Majesty who's wrong, it's you who's wrong." "Do you think His Majesty, the great Ninth Five-Year Plan, will pay for your mistakes?" "You think too highly of yourself." What's more, judging from the current situation, the emperor obviously wants to take advantage of Liu Wen and Tang Jing and others.If you plagiarize, His Majesty will not only not be able to protect you, but he will be so happy that he will drink three hundred glasses of wine. After all, you have provided him with a good excuse to deal with your father.Of course, Tang Yi could only complain secretly in his heart. Such words could not be said in public.After hearing Tang Yi's words, Tang Hua's face instantly lost all color, and there was no trace of the arrogance and arrogance he had before.Tang Yi had indeed reminded him, but at that time, in his eyes, Tang Yi was nothing more than an ant-like waste.Does he need to care about what a loser says?But now, his whole body was swallowed up by fear, and he finally knew that he was afraid.Tang Yi was right, he was not important enough for the emperor of a country to abandon his principles for him."Xiao Yi, I was wrong, help me, help me..." Tang Hua looked at the shining long sword in King Fu's hand, his legs were weakening, and he almost knelt on the ground: "Xiao Yi, we are brothers! We are brothers whose blood is thicker than water, please help me." "I don't want to die, I can't die!" Tang Hua stood beside Tang Yi, lowered his head and clenched his fists, and said in a voice that could only be heard by the two of them.His voice was urgent and trembling, almost making him cry.If the opponent is Tang Yi, he will confuse right and wrong and make up a set of rhetoric at will to make himself invincible.After all, it was difficult for Tang Yi to prove his innocence, but facing King Fu, he didn't even have the courage to confuse right and wrong.That was the person who dared to fight the Beidi army single-handedly during the Jingkang shame period!More importantly, the other party is a relative of the emperor!A royal relative with real power in his hands!Tang Yi listened to Tang Hua's plea for help and looked at him with even more disdain.Whenever Tang Hua dares to make mistakes and argue with Prince Fu in public, even if he loses, Tang Yi will look down upon him.Turns out, this guy is just a hypocritical egoist!When something is beneficial to him, he magnifies it countless times, hoping to let everyone in the world know about it.But once the situation goes against you, you will find ways to get yourself out first.shameful!"Begging me?" Tang Yi sneered."Tang Hua, with your attitude today, you wish you could chop me into pieces and scatter my bones into ashes, right?" "As soon as you come up, you pick up that woman Jiang Yunna and make trouble for me, belittle and trample on me, isn't that just to create more legitimate opportunities for you to take action?"Is that so?""They set the stage very well. You should step on me with all your strength. This is what you should do.""But now you are asking me... to let you go?"After that, Tang Yi's voice turned cold.Let Tang Hua go?What a joke!In order to kill him today, this guy was fully prepared. Which one of them was not aimed at ruining his reputation?He should have died long ago!"Tang Yi, don't go too far." "We are all descendants of the Tang family. If we really go to the point of life and death, it will be the shame of the Tang family." "Father...Father will not let you go." Tang Hua's eyes turned red when he saw old King Fu already on stage.He moved out of Tang Jing directly and used Tang Jing to threaten Tang Yi.Damn it, it's your honor to beg you, and you still dare to mock me?However.Tang Yi glanced at him when he heard this, as if he was looking at an idiot."Tang family? Does it have something to do with me?" "Don't you like to confuse right and wrong and be eloquent? Then argue with Prince Fu!" After saying this, Tang Yi stood up and bowed his hands to the angry Prince Fu: "I've met the prince, I'm sorry, I just followed the prince's wishes and wrote down the words... I didn't expect that someone used them." "Boy, this has nothing to do with you." Old Prince Fu waved his hand at Tang Yi casually, staring at Tang Hua with cold eyes.When he first asked Tang Yi to copy "Spring Hope", he wanted to be like the old general Di Cang and wanted the original copy of his little poetry fairy.But he didn't expect that by some mistake, Tang Hua would be taken to the palace examination to show off.Those are his poems, but someone dares to steal them!"You are the number one scholar who passed three yuan, Tang Hua, right?" King Fu raised his sword and pointed at Tang Hua: "Who gave you the courage to steal the poem written by Tang Yi boy for me, and use it to mock and humiliate His Majesty in the palace examination in order to win the number one prize?!" Hearing this, the whole place fell silent almost instantly.Everyone's eyes fell on Tang Hua.Emperor Yanwen, Liu Wen, Tang Jing and others also looked over.At this time, their faces were all surprisingly the same, all extremely gloomy, and they were all waiting for Tang Hua's answer.On the day of the imperial examination, Tang Hua's "Poem of Admonition" amazed the audience. If this poem was really plagiarized by Tang Yi, it would be the biggest scandal in the entire history of the Dayan Imperial Examination!The one who was hit was the face of the entire Dayan court and the Dayan literary world.In an instant, the entire atmosphere of Luming Lake became oppressive, like the calm before the storm.And Tang Hua was originally a good-for-nothing and fun-loving loser. He only wanted to make trouble secretly and did not have such a strong mentality to support his wild ambitions.
title_en: Chapter 118 You are not worthy to be my opponent!
